errors.source_too_large: The folder is larger than the import limits: 2048 files, 16 MB per file, 64 MB in total.

errors.manifest_missing: The folder has no SKILL.md file.

errors.name_taken: A skill with this name is already in the library.
errors.source_url_invalid: Enter an HTTP(S) address without credentials.
errors.source_revision_invalid: A revision may only contain printable characters without spaces.
errors.not_found: This skill is no longer in the library.
errors.revision_conflict: Another change was saved first. Reload and try again.
errors.invalid_stored_skill: Stored skill metadata is invalid and was left unchanged.
